The actual CM19 degree-four cover has a complete ramification divisor: its invariant differential gives the canonical line `2X+Z=0`, whose full homogeneous quartic section factors as `2(V−4U)(V−5U)(V²+4UV+6U²)`, with no infinity zero. Exact quotient-field evaluation gives four distinct branch values: `(3,2)`, `(3,5)` and the quadratic orbit `u²+4u+6=0, v=u+1`. The residual pair's elliptic group sum is `(5,1)`. Written proofs 604246/de29b0 identify the actual geometric interpretation through named canonical, tame RH and parent-map hypotheses. [pcc:unverified]

Validation: native B source `3c6d3b26` and C source `c17417cd` each pass all seven strict phases with guards unchanged, after 51/72 locked whole-file readbacks. B retains the complete 17-row canonical certificate and full factor reconstruction. C retains all 49 Frobenius/norm records, 48 inverses, both actual residual images, full branch equality matrix and real numerator mutations/restoration. Full stdout is 3915/6467 bytes, with 40 whole small originals per run (2bf624/147cd6). The full geometric formalization and independent signed standing remain open. [pcc:unverified]

The inspected [two-page report](https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto/blob/lane/chained-cm19-ramification-20261124/research/chained_cm19_ramification_20261124/reports/run-20261124T0200Z/REPORT.pdf) (da1af3) gives every actual point/image, Frobenius diagram, quotient-field formula and proof boundary. Preserve first A's strict-Clippy negative with no native case execution (f005a4), the first TeX markup failure and all original sources/evidence. Whole original B/C ELFs remain RAM-pending approved durable custody. [pcc:unverified]

Stacked on #5103. The native-only focused workflow uses allowed official rustup and unchanged source/tool hashes and 120s/2GiB/one-worker bounds; preparation passes syntax/actionlint (a11200), actual ready-head CI is pending. Required/applicable checks, parent dependencies and the frozen main ledger fork remain merge holds. First head review is at least 50 minutes after the latest substantive push/ready, with all-attempt checks/all-event runs and cap30; no reruns or waivers. Continue the persistent queue into concrete S4 sign/cubic resolvents and test whether their natural Jacobian correspondences carry more than the common elliptic factor. [pcc:unverified]
